question: Were you married at the end of last year, and does anyone live with you that you support?
why_ask: Filing status sets the standard deduction, tax rates and filing threshold.
retrieval_query: how to choose filing status single head of household

question: Were you (or your spouse, if filing jointly) born before January 2, 1961?
why_ask: Taxpayers 65 or older get a larger standard deduction federally and a senior exemption credit in California.
retrieval_query: standard deduction age 65 or older additional amount

question: Did you live in California for all of last year?
why_ask: Full-year residents file Form 540; part-year residents and nonresidents file Form 540NR.

question: Did you receive Social Security benefits last year?
why_ask: Up to 85% of benefits can be taxable federally; California does not tax Social Security at all.
source: IRS Pub 915; FTB Schedule CA (540) instructions

question: What is the net benefit amount in Box 5 of your SSA-1099?
why_ask: The taxable part depends on benefits plus other income (provisional income).
retrieval_query: how much of social security benefits is taxable worksheet

question: Did you take money out of a pension, 401(k), IRA or annuity last year?
why_ask: Retirement distributions are reported on Form 1099-R and are often taxable.
retrieval_query: pensions and annuities IRA distributions taxable

question: What is the total gross distribution in Box 1 of your 1099-R forms?
why_ask: The gross amount and the taxable amount (Box 2a) can differ; both go on the return.

question: Were you younger than 59 and a half when you took any of that money?
why_ask: Early distributions may owe an additional tax unless an exception applies.
retrieval_query: additional tax on early distributions 59 1/2 exceptions

question: Did you move any of that money into another retirement account?
why_ask: A properly completed rollover is not taxable.
required_docs: rollover confirmation from the receiving account

question: Did you work for pay last year?
why_ask: Wages add to income and can make more of the Social Security benefit taxable.
retrieval_query: earned income retirees social security taxable

question: What is the total in Box 1 of your W-2 forms?
why_ask: Wages count toward provisional income and the regular tax.

question: Did you send any estimated tax payments to the IRS or the FTB last year?
why_ask: Retirees without enough withholding often pay estimated tax; payments are credited on the return.
retrieval_query: estimated tax payments who must pay
